source_consistency_findings.description: The report uses d0=26 mm for M20 class B; the ordinary Table 40 route permits db+(1,2,3) mm and therefore requires explicit exceptional applicability if any.
Eq.(189) cannot size a moment-loaded bolt group by reusing Nb,max derived from the geometry of a 50-bolt group; the group geometry must be iterated.
Clause 14.2.14 increases bolt count, not the already-derived force per bolt.
The source bearing-resistance route after the SP385 multiplier is retained as an unresolved cross-standard dependency, not tuned into SP16 core.
